description: This file defines a NetworkStatusService class responsible for asynchronously checking the current network status and interface types using NWPathMonitor. It provides methods to get the current network status with a timeout, handle path updates, and generate payloads representing network conditions. Additionally, it includes a private state management class to ensure the completion handler is called only once.

classes.name: NetworkStatusService
classes.description: Final class providing network status fetching with async method, using NWPathMonitor and continuation.

classes.name: NetworkStatusState
classes.description: Private helper class managing completion state with thread safety.

methods.name: currentStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the current network status with a specified timeout, using NWPathMonitor and continuations.

methods.name: payload(from:)
methods.description: Constructs a payload from NWPath, indicating network status and interface types.

methods.name: fallbackPayload
methods.description: Provides a default network status payload when monitoring times out or fails.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks the state as completed in a thread-safe manner, ensuring callback is invoked only once.
